Reused the exact text/url/code/note fields from semester-plan-generator_btp_g8_ela_pacing.json (the stored per-LP pacing); only added which week each activity's guide table names it, from the guide's own per-week 'Visions Standards Gap Activities' row. Week 23 labels its row 'Visions' Supplemental Lesson' rather than 'Visions Standards Gap Activities', again matched by bookmark id.cd17lcyy7oo. All 13 gap activities (LP2-LP8; LP1, LP9, LP10 have none) land within their stored LP's week window, and no Science/HSS-coded activities or stray codes without a matching link were found in this guide's ELA gap rows. NO CURSIVE ENTRY: matching Grade 7's schema, this file has no top-level 'cursive' key. The guide's own Understanding the Language Arts Components table shows no Printing/Cursive column marked for grade 8 (confirmed against the Zearn math guide's parallel table, which lists Printing/Cursive as blank for grades 4-8), and the stored semester-plan-generator_btp_g8_ela_pacing.json has zero mentions of a weekly cursive assignment across all 10 LPs. This means Grade 8 genuinely doesn't carry a cursive component, consistent with the recent_updates note confirming this with Loren.
